words.enDefinition: Study of motion and relationships between motion, forces, and moments

examples.en: Our engineering dynamics class compared the motion of two carts after the same push.
examples.zh: 我们的「工程动力学」课比较了两辆小车受到相同推力后的运动。

examples.en: We used engineering dynamics to connect the wheel's changing rotation with the applied moment.
examples.zh: 我们用「工程动力学」把车轮转动的变化与施加的力矩联系起来。

words.enDefinition: Description of rigid-body motion through position, orientation, velocity, and acceleration

examples.en: We used rigid-body kinematics to compare velocities at two points on the same plate.
examples.zh: 我们用「刚体运动学」比较同一平板上两点的速度。

examples.en: The rigid-body kinematics exercise specifies the disk's motion before asking about a marked point.
examples.zh: 「刚体运动学」练习先给出圆盘的运动，再询问其中一个标记点的运动。

words.enDefinition: Study linking forces and moments to the motion of rigid bodies

examples.en: In rigid-body kinetics, the same moment can produce different angular accelerations in disks with different inertia.
examples.zh: 在「刚体动力学」中，相同的力矩作用于质量分布不同的圆盘，可以产生不同的角加速度。

examples.en: Our rigid-body kinetics exercise relates the forces on a sliding plate to its acceleration.
examples.zh: 我们的「刚体动力学」练习把滑动平板所受的力与其加速度联系起来。

words.enDefinition: Motion with all points moving in planes parallel to a fixed plane

examples.en: We modeled the wheel as exhibiting planar rigid-body motion along the straight laboratory track.
examples.zh: 我们把车轮沿实验室直轨的运动建模为「刚体平面运动」。

examples.en: The tutor used planar rigid-body motion to separate the plate's overall translation from its rotation.
examples.zh: 老师用「刚体平面运动」说明如何区分平板的整体平移和转动。

words.enDefinition: Motion preserving body orientation so every point has the same displacement

examples.en: The platform undergoes pure translation because its edge keeps pointing in the same direction.
examples.zh: 平台的边缘始终指向同一个方向，因此平台做「纯平移」。

examples.en: During pure translation, both marked corners have identical velocity vectors at each instant.
examples.zh: 做「纯平移」时，两个带标记的角在每个时刻都有相同的速度向量。

words.enDefinition: Motion with constant body orientation and parallel straight-line paths for all points

examples.en: We used rectilinear translation for the display panel that slides along a straight rail.
examples.zh: 我们用「直线平移」描述沿直轨滑动的展板。

examples.en: The body maintains its orientation throughout the rectilinear translation shown in the figure.
examples.zh: 在图示的整个「直线平移」中，物体的朝向保持不变。

words.enDefinition: Motion with constant body orientation while its points follow curved paths

examples.en: The cabin undergoes curvilinear translation when its floor stays level along the curved path.
examples.zh: 小舱沿曲线路径移动时，地板保持水平，因此小舱做「曲线平移」。

examples.en: Our diagram illustrates curvilinear translation by showing the body's unchanged orientation at three points.
examples.zh: 示意图显示物体在三个位置的朝向保持一致，以说明「曲线平移」。

words.enDefinition: Motion in which a rigid body rotates around an axis fixed in space

examples.en: The classroom model uses fixed-axis rotation for a colored wheel mounted at its center.
examples.zh: 课堂模型用「定轴转动」描述安装在固定中心处的彩色轮。

examples.en: In fixed-axis rotation, points away from the axis follow circles perpendicular to it.
examples.zh: 做「定轴转动」时，离开轴线的点沿与轴线垂直的圆运动。

words.enDefinition: Line about which an object turns during the motion being analyzed

examples.en: The dashed line through the center marks the axis of rotation in our drawing.
examples.zh: 我们图中穿过中心的虚线标出了「转动轴线」。

examples.en: We measured each marker's distance from the axis of rotation before comparing its speed.
examples.zh: 比较各标记点的速度之前，我们先测量了各点到「转动轴线」的距离。

collocations: distance from the axis of rotation

words.enDefinition: Orientation measured by an angle from a chosen reference direction

examples.en: We marked the zero direction before recording the disk's angular position in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先标出零角方向，再在图中记录圆盘的「角位置」。

examples.en: The graph gives angular position at successive times during one turn of the disk.
examples.zh: 图中给出了圆盘转一圈期间各时刻的「角位置」。

words.enDefinition: Signed change in orientation around a chosen axis between two times

examples.en: We calculated the angular displacement from the two angles shown in the measurement log.
examples.zh: 我们用测量记录表上的两个角求出了「角位移」。

examples.en: The signed angular displacement is negative when the disk turns opposite our chosen direction.
examples.zh: 圆盘朝我们选定方向的反方向转动时，带符号的「角位移」为负。

words.enDefinition: A vector describing the instantaneous rate and axis of rotation, with its sign or direction given by the right-hand convention.

examples.en: The slope of our angle graph gives the wheel's angular velocity at that moment.
examples.zh: 角度曲线的斜率给出车轮在那个时刻的「角速度」。

examples.en: Both marked points share the same angular velocity because they belong to one disk.
examples.zh: 两个标记点具有相同的「角速度」，因为它们都在同一个圆盘上。

words.enDefinition: The time derivative of angular velocity, describing how rotational speed or the rotation axis changes.

examples.en: We found the angular acceleration from the slope of the angular velocity graph.
examples.zh: 我们根据角速度曲线的斜率求出了「角加速度」。

examples.en: The disk has zero angular acceleration while it turns steadily about its fixed axis.
examples.zh: 圆盘绕定轴匀速转动时，「角加速度」为零。

words.enDefinition: magnitude of angular velocity, independent of the direction of rotation

examples.en: The disks have equal angular speed values although they rotate in opposite directions.
examples.zh: 尽管两个圆盘的转动方向相反，它们的「角速率」相等。

examples.en: We compared the angular speed of the two wheels during the same time interval.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两个轮子在同一时间段内的「角速率」。

words.enDefinition: Unit expressing angular change in radians for each second of elapsed time

examples.en: The worksheet reports angular speed in radians per second before asking for rim speed.
examples.zh: 习题给出的角速率单位是「弧度每秒」，随后要求求出轮缘速率。

examples.en: We converted the reading to radians per second before multiplying it by the radius.
examples.zh: 我们先把读数换算为「弧度每秒」，再乘以半径。

collocations: express angular velocity in radians per second

words.enDefinition: Unit counting complete rotations during one minute at a specified rate

examples.en: The display reports the wheel's rotation in revolutions per minute during the demonstration.
examples.zh: 演示时，显示屏以「转每分钟」为单位报告轮子的转速。

examples.en: We converted revolutions per minute before comparing the wheel with the angular speed calculation.
examples.zh: 我们将读数从「转每分钟」换算成所需单位，再与车轮角速率的计算值作比较。

words.enDefinition: Frame where an object with zero net force keeps constant velocity

examples.en: The model treats the stationary laboratory floor as an inertial reference frame for the cart.
examples.zh: 在小车模型中，静止的实验室地板视为「惯性参考系」。

examples.en: We described the forces after choosing an inertial reference frame for our motion equations.
examples.zh: 我们先为运动方程选定「惯性参考系」，再描述各个力。

collocations: motion in an inertial reference frame

words.enDefinition: Equation relating two rigid-body point velocities through the body's angular velocity

examples.en: We used the relative velocity equation to find the velocity at the second marked point.
examples.zh: 我们用「相对速度方程」求出第二个标记点的速度。

examples.en: The relative velocity equation combines the known point velocity with a term from rotation.
examples.zh: 「相对速度方程」将已知点的速度和旋转产生的一项结合起来。

words.enDefinition: Equation linking point accelerations on a rigid body through its rotation

examples.en: The relative acceleration equation includes terms for angular acceleration and the square of angular speed.
examples.zh: 「相对加速度方程」包含与角加速度和角速率平方有关的项。

examples.en: We used the relative acceleration equation after finding the acceleration of the reference point.
examples.zh: 求出参考点的加速度后，我们使用了「相对加速度方程」。

words.enDefinition: Acceleration component along a path's tangent that changes an object's speed

examples.en: The wheel has zero tangential acceleration at its rim while its rotation stays steady.
examples.zh: 车轮保持匀速转动时，轮缘上的点的「切向加速度」为零。

examples.en: We found the tangential acceleration from the change in speed along the circular path.
examples.zh: 我们根据速率沿圆形路径的变化，求出了「切向加速度」。

words.enDefinition: Inward acceleration component directed toward the center of curvature of a path

examples.en: A point on the rim has centripetal acceleration even during rotation at constant speed.
examples.zh: 即使匀速转动，轮缘上的一个点也有「向心加速度」。

examples.en: The arrow for centripetal acceleration points directly toward the center of the circular path.
examples.zh: 「向心加速度」的箭头直接指向圆形路径的中心。

words.enDefinition: Point with zero velocity at an instant in nontranslating planar rigid-body motion

examples.en: For our rolling wheel, the instantaneous center of zero velocity lies at the point touching the stationary track.
examples.zh: 对于我们研究的滚动车轮，「速度瞬心」位于接触静止轨道的点。

examples.en: We located the instantaneous center of zero velocity using perpendicular lines through two points with known velocity directions.
examples.zh: 我们通过两个速度方向已知的点作各自速度的垂线，找到了「速度瞬心」。

collocations: locate the instantaneous center of zero velocity
use the instantaneous center of zero velocity
draw the instantaneous center of zero velocity

words.enDefinition: Position obtained by averaging the locations of mass with mass-based weights

examples.en: The uneven plate's center of mass lies nearer the side with more material.
examples.zh: 不均匀平板的「质心」更靠近材料较多的一侧。

examples.en: We tracked the center of mass separately from the marked point on the rotating rim.
examples.zh: 我们分别追踪了「质心」和转动轮缘上的标记点。

collocations: motion of the center of mass

words.enDefinition: Measure of rotational inertia calculated by weighting mass by squared axis distance

examples.en: The mass moment of inertia increases when more of the same mass lies farther from the axis.
examples.zh: 当相同总质量中有更多质量位于远离轴线的位置时，「转动惯量」增大。

examples.en: We specified the axis before finding the plate's mass moment of inertia in the exercise.
examples.zh: 在习题中求平板的「转动惯量」之前，我们先指定了轴线。

collocations: calculate the mass moment of inertia
mass moment of inertia about an axis

words.enDefinition: Distance where concentrating total mass would give the same rotational inertia

examples.en: We found the mass radius of gyration from the body's mass and its moment of inertia.
examples.zh: 我们用物体的质量及其转动惯量求出了「质量回转半径」。

examples.en: The mass radius of gyration changes when we choose a different axis for the same plate.
examples.zh: 对同一块平板选择不同轴线时，「质量回转半径」会变化。

collocations: calculate the mass radius of gyration
mass radius of gyration about an axis
interpret the mass radius of gyration

words.enDefinition: Rule relating inertia about the center-of-mass axis to inertia about a parallel axis
acceptedZhAnswers: 质量惯性矩平行轴定理

examples.en: We used the parallel-axis theorem for mass to shift from the central axis to a parallel line.
examples.zh: 我们用「转动惯量平行轴定理」将转动惯量从过质心的轴换算到其平行轴。

examples.en: The parallel-axis theorem for mass adds a term involving mass and the squared distance between axes.
examples.zh: 「转动惯量平行轴定理」要加上一项，这一项等于质量乘以两轴间距的平方。

collocations: apply the parallel-axis theorem for mass
use the parallel-axis theorem for mass
verify the parallel-axis theorem for mass

words.enDefinition: Equations relating net forces and moments to a rigid body's motion

examples.en: We used the Newton-Euler equations to relate the plate's translation and rotation to external loads.
examples.zh: 我们用「牛顿欧拉方程」将平板的平移和转动与外载荷联系起来。

examples.en: The Newton-Euler equations in our problem include a moment equation about the moving mass center.
examples.zh: 题目中的「牛顿欧拉方程」包含一个关于运动质心的力矩方程。

words.enDefinition: Vector obtained by multiplying an object's mass by its velocity

examples.en: The two carts have equal linear momentum values when their masses and velocities match.
examples.zh: 两辆小车的质量和速度分别相同时，它们的「线动量」相等。

examples.en: We drew an arrow for the cart's linear momentum along its velocity direction.
examples.zh: 我们沿小车的速度方向画出箭头来表示它的「线动量」。

words.enDefinition: Sum of position cross momentum for particles measured from a specified reference point

examples.en: We measured angular momentum about the marked axis for the turning disk in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上测量了转动圆盘绕标记轴的「角动量」。

examples.en: The value of angular momentum in the worksheet depends on the chosen reference point.
examples.zh: 习题中「角动量」的值取决于所选参考点。

words.enDefinition: Time integral of a force, giving its accumulated effect over an interval

examples.en: We calculated linear impulse from the area under the force curve in our example.
examples.zh: 我们用示例中力曲线下方的带符号面积求出「线冲量」。

examples.en: The same linear impulse can result from different force histories in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 在课堂模型中，力随时间的不同变化过程可以产生相同的「线冲量」。

collocations: linear impulse delivered by a force

words.enDefinition: Time integral of a moment about a specified point or axis

examples.en: We found angular impulse from the signed area under the torque versus time graph.
examples.zh: 我们根据力矩随时间变化的图线下的带符号面积求出「角冲量」。

examples.en: Two different torque histories produced equal angular impulse about the axis in our model.
examples.zh: 在我们的模型中，两种不同的力矩变化过程产生了相同的绕轴「角冲量」。

collocations: angular impulse about a fixed axis

words.enDefinition: Rule equating net external force impulse to the change in linear momentum

examples.en: The linear impulse-momentum principle relates the impulse during the push to the cart's momentum change.
examples.zh: 「线冲量动量原理」把推动时的冲量与小车动量的变化联系起来。

examples.en: We used the linear impulse-momentum principle to calculate the cart's change in velocity after a brief push.
examples.zh: 我们用「线冲量动量原理」计算短暂推动后小车速度的变化。

words.enDefinition: External torque impulse about a fixed point equals the angular momentum change

examples.en: We applied the angular impulse-momentum principle to a disk under a moment that changed with time.
examples.zh: 我们将「角冲量动量原理」用于受到随时间变化的力矩作用的圆盘。

examples.en: The angular impulse-momentum principle related the measured moment history to the change in angular momentum.
examples.zh: 「角冲量动量原理」把实测的力矩变化过程与角动量的变化联系起来。

words.enDefinition: Constant total momentum of a system when net external force is zero

examples.en: We used conservation of linear momentum for two carts with negligible external impulse during their interaction.
examples.zh: 两辆小车相互作用期间，外力冲量可忽略，因此我们使用了「线动量守恒」。

examples.en: The model illustrates conservation of linear momentum by comparing total momentum before and after contact.
examples.zh: 模型通过比较接触前后的总动量来说明「线动量守恒」。

words.enDefinition: Constant angular momentum about a fixed point when external moment vanishes there

examples.en: We used conservation of angular momentum to explain why the model spins faster as mass moves inward.
examples.zh: 我们用「角动量守恒」说明质量向轴线移近时，模型为什么转得更快。

examples.en: We assumed conservation of angular momentum about the vertical axis because the external moment was negligible.
examples.zh: 由于绕竖直轴的外力矩可忽略，我们假定绕该轴的「角动量守恒」。

words.enDefinition: Motion energy associated with the speed of a body's center of mass

examples.en: We calculated the cart's translational kinetic energy from its mass and center-of-mass speed.
examples.zh: 我们用小车的质量和质心速率求出了它的「平动动能」。

examples.en: The rolling disk has translational kinetic energy because its center moves along the track.
examples.zh: 滚动圆盘具有「平动动能」，因为其圆心沿轨道移动。

words.enDefinition: Motion energy associated with a body's rotation about the selected axis

examples.en: Increasing the disk's angular speed increases its rotational kinetic energy when the inertia is unchanged.
examples.zh: 当质量惯性矩不变时，提高圆盘的角速率会增加它的「转动动能」。

examples.en: We calculated rotational kinetic energy about the disk's center before adding the translational term.
examples.zh: 我们先算出圆盘绕其中心的「转动动能」，再加上平动项。

words.enDefinition: Rule equating net work on the modeled system to its kinetic energy change

examples.en: We used the work-energy principle to predict the cart's speed after a steady pull.
examples.zh: 我们用「动能定理」预测持续拉动后小车的速率。

examples.en: The work-energy principle connects the work done in turning the disk with its kinetic energy change.
examples.zh: 「动能定理」将转动圆盘所做的功与其动能变化联系起来。

words.enDefinition: Rate of work equal to the dot product of torque and angular velocity

examples.en: We found rotational power by multiplying the shaft torque by its angular velocity.
examples.zh: 我们将轴上的力矩乘以其角速度，求出了「转动功率」。

examples.en: The model's rotational power rises as the speed increases under the same torque.
examples.zh: 力矩不变时，随着转速增大，模型的「转动功率」升高。

words.enDefinition: Rolling in which the contacting bodies have zero relative velocity at their point of contact.

examples.en: In rolling without slipping, the wheel center's speed equals its radius times its angular speed.
examples.zh: 在「纯滚动」中，轮心速率等于车轮半径与角速率的乘积。

examples.en: We assumed rolling without slipping before using the wheel's rotation to calculate distance along the track.
examples.zh: 我们先假定「纯滚动」，再用车轮的转动量计算沿轨道移动的距离。

words.enDefinition: Ratio of separation speed to approach speed along the line of impact

examples.en: We found the coefficient of restitution using the two relative speeds of the colliding carts.
examples.zh: 我们用相碰小车的接近和分离相对速率求出了「恢复系数」。

examples.en: The coefficient of restitution was zero in the example where both carts stayed together.
examples.zh: 在两辆小车碰后粘在一起的例子中，「恢复系数」为零。

collocations: coefficient of restitution for an impact

words.enDefinition: Collision during which the interacting system's total kinetic energy is conserved

examples.en: Our simulation uses a perfectly elastic collision and preserves the two carts' total kinetic energy.
examples.zh: 我们的仿真实现了「完全弹性碰撞」，两辆小车的总动能保持不变。

examples.en: The tutor compared the cart speeds before and after the perfectly elastic collision in class.
examples.zh: 老师在课堂上比较了小车在「完全弹性碰撞」前后的速率。

collocations: example of a perfectly elastic collision

words.enDefinition: Collision in which the objects remain joined and move together afterward

examples.en: The toy carts join and move together after the perfectly inelastic collision in our example.
examples.zh: 在我们的示例中，两辆玩具车在「完全非弹性碰撞」后连在一起运动。

examples.en: We used a perfectly inelastic collision to compare the kinetic energy before and after contact.
examples.zh: 我们用「完全非弹性碰撞」比较接触前后的动能。

collocations: example of a perfectly inelastic collision

words.enDefinition: Individual component serving a distinct mechanical role in a larger assembly

examples.en: We chose a machine element from the diagram and described what it does.
examples.zh: 我们从图中选了一个「机械元件」，并描述了它的作用。

examples.en: The worksheet asks which machine element transfers the rotation between the two assemblies.
examples.zh: 习题问哪个「机械元件」在两个组件之间传递转动。

words.enDefinition: Rotating member transmitting torque from a driver to another component

examples.en: The drive shaft carries rotation from the small motor to the demonstration wheel.
examples.zh: 「传动轴」将小电机的转动传递给演示用的轮子。

examples.en: We labeled the drive shaft connecting the motor and gearbox in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图中标出了连接电机和齿轮箱的「传动轴」。

words.enDefinition: Rotating member delivering motion and torque from a device to its load

examples.en: The output shaft in the model rotates more slowly than the motor input.
examples.zh: 模型中的「输出轴」比电机输入端转得慢。

examples.en: We traced the output shaft from the gearbox to the rotating display plate.
examples.zh: 我们沿「输出轴」追踪从齿轮箱到旋转展板的传动路径。

words.enDefinition: Component joining two shafts so that torque can pass between them

examples.en: The diagram places a shaft coupling between the motor and the test shaft.
examples.zh: 图中在电机和试验轴之间设置了一个「联轴器」。

examples.en: We marked the shaft coupling where the two shaft ends join in the model.
examples.zh: 我们标出了模型中连接两个轴端的「联轴器」。

words.enDefinition: Shaft connection that maintains fixed alignment with essentially no intentional flexibility

examples.en: The rigid coupling in our model connects two shafts on the same centerline.
examples.zh: 我们模型中的「刚性联轴器」连接位于同一中心线上的两根轴。

examples.en: We drew a rigid coupling to show how aligned shafts rotate together.
examples.zh: 我们画出一个「刚性联轴器」，演示已对中的轴如何一起转动。

words.enDefinition: Shaft connection designed to transmit torque while accommodating limited relative movement

examples.en: The diagram shows a flexible coupling allowing slight angular differences between connected shafts.
examples.zh: 图中显示一个「挠性联轴器」，可以容纳相连两轴之间的小角度偏差。

examples.en: We compared the flexible coupling with a solid connection in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂模型中将「挠性联轴器」与刚性联接作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Offset between shaft centerlines that remain parallel to one another

examples.en: The drawing shows parallel misalignment because the shaft centerlines are offset but stay parallel.
examples.zh: 图中两轴中心线错开但保持平行，体现了「平行不对中」。

examples.en: We distinguished parallel misalignment from shafts meeting at an angle in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在习题中区分了「平行不对中」和轴线成角度相交的情况。

words.enDefinition: Difference in the directions of two nominally aligned shaft centerlines

examples.en: We recognized angular misalignment because the two shaft centerlines pointed in different directions.
examples.zh: 由于两轴中心线指向不同方向，我们识别出了「角度不对中」。

examples.en: The sketch shows angular misalignment between two shafts that meet at an angle.
examples.zh: 草图显示两根成角度相交的轴之间存在「角度不对中」。

words.enDefinition: Ring fastened around a shaft to locate another part or limit movement

examples.en: The shaft collar in the drawing limits how far the wheel can slide.
examples.zh: 图中的「轴环」限制了车轮可沿轴滑动的距离。

examples.en: We marked a shaft collar next to the spacer on the tabletop model.
examples.zh: 我们在桌面模型的隔套旁标出了一个「轴环」。

collocations: locate a part with a shaft collar

words.enDefinition: Small piece fitting shaft and hub slots to transmit torque between them

examples.en: The diagram shows a shaft key connecting the wheel hub and its shaft.
examples.zh: 图中显示一枚「轴键」连接轮毂与其轴。

examples.en: We shaded the shaft key to show which part prevents relative rotation here.
examples.zh: 我们给「轴键」涂上阴影，表示此处是哪个零件限制相对转动。

collocations: fit a shaft key into a slot

words.enDefinition: Slot in a shaft or hub that receives a torque-transmitting key

examples.en: The shaft drawing includes a keyway running along its top surface.
examples.zh: 轴的图纸上画了一个沿其顶部表面延伸的「键槽」。

examples.en: We found the keyway by looking for the recess inside the hub.
examples.zh: 我们通过查找轮毂内的凹槽找到了「键槽」。

words.enDefinition: Ring fitting a groove to restrict movement along a shaft or bore

examples.en: The retaining ring sits in a groove next to the sliding ring in the drawing.
examples.zh: 图中的「挡圈」位于滑环旁边的一道凹槽内。

examples.en: We labeled the retaining ring that keeps the spacer from sliding off the shaft.
examples.zh: 我们标出了防止隔套滑出轴端的「挡圈」。

collocations: axial stop provided by a retaining ring

words.enDefinition: Bearing supporting relative motion through sliding surfaces, possibly separated by lubricant

examples.en: The plain bearing in the model supports the shaft on a smooth cylindrical surface.
examples.zh: 模型中的「滑动轴承」通过光滑的圆柱面支撑轴。

examples.en: We compared a plain bearing with a bearing containing moving rolling elements.
examples.zh: 我们将「滑动轴承」与含有滚动元件的轴承作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Plain bearing supporting a rotating shaft at a cylindrical journal surface

examples.en: The drawing places a journal bearing around the cylindrical section of the drive shaft.
examples.zh: 图中在传动轴的圆柱形轴颈外设置了「轴颈轴承」。

examples.en: We traced the sideways load from the shaft into the journal bearing.
examples.zh: 我们追踪了横向载荷从轴传递到「轴颈轴承」的路径。

words.enDefinition: Bearing carrying loads through balls or rollers moving between race surfaces

examples.en: The rolling-element bearing in the cutaway uses small balls between two rings.
examples.zh: 剖开示意图中的「滚动轴承」在两个套圈之间使用小滚珠。

examples.en: We sketched the rolling-element bearing before identifying its rolling and stationary components.
examples.zh: 我们先画了「滚动轴承」的草图，再识别滚动和固定的元件。

words.enDefinition: Rolling-element bearing that supports loads with spherical rolling components

examples.en: We identified a ball bearing by the row of spheres in the cutaway.
examples.zh: 我们根据剖开示意图中的一排球体识别出「球轴承」。

examples.en: The ball bearing supports the rotating shaft inside the small demonstration wheel.
examples.zh: 「球轴承」支撑小型演示轮内的转轴。

words.enDefinition: Rolling-element bearing using rollers as the components that carry load

examples.en: The roller bearing in our sketch uses cylindrical rolling elements to carry the load.
examples.zh: 我们草图中的「滚子轴承」采用圆柱形滚动元件承受载荷。

examples.en: We compared the shape of each rolling component in the roller bearing.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「滚子轴承」中各滚动元件的形状。

words.enDefinition: Bearing intended primarily to support loads perpendicular to the shaft axis

examples.en: A radial bearing supports the shaft against the sideways force shown in the diagram.
examples.zh: 「径向轴承」支撑轴，使其承受图示的侧向力。

examples.en: We marked the radial bearing carrying the wheel's load perpendicular to its axis.
examples.zh: 我们标出了沿垂直轴线方向承受轮子载荷的「径向轴承」。

words.enDefinition: Bearing intended primarily to support load acting along the shaft axis

examples.en: The model's thrust bearing takes the force directed along the vertical shaft.
examples.zh: 模型中的「推力轴承」承受沿竖直轴方向的力。

examples.en: We used a thrust bearing symbol for the support taking the axial force.
examples.zh: 我们用「推力轴承」符号表示承受轴向力的支承。

collocations: axial load on a thrust bearing

words.enDefinition: Ring of a rolling bearing carrying a track for rolling elements

examples.en: The inner bearing race turns with the shaft in our simplified assembly.
examples.zh: 在我们的简化组件中，内「轴承套圈」随轴转动。

examples.en: We marked the outer bearing race in the part of the drawing held stationary.
examples.zh: 我们在图中保持静止的位置标出了外「轴承套圈」。

words.enDefinition: Component that separates and guides rolling elements around a bearing

examples.en: The bearing cage keeps neighboring balls spaced apart as they move around the ring.
examples.zh: 滚珠沿套圈转动时，「轴承保持架」使相邻滚珠彼此隔开。

examples.en: We removed the outer ring from the drawing to reveal the bearing cage.
examples.zh: 我们在图中隐藏外圈，让「轴承保持架」显露出来。

words.enDefinition: Available movement between bearing components measured in a specified direction

examples.en: The animation exaggerates bearing clearance so viewers can see the available relative movement.
examples.zh: 动画放大了「轴承游隙」，以便观众看清可发生的相对运动。

examples.en: Our model distinguishes bearing clearance along the shaft from clearance perpendicular to it.
examples.zh: 我们的模型区分了沿轴方向与垂直于轴方向的「轴承游隙」。

words.enDefinition: Arrangement of interacting gears that transmits motion between input and output

examples.en: We drew a gear train with three gears and marked the input first.
examples.zh: 我们画了一个由三个齿轮组成的「齿轮系」，并先标出输入端。

examples.en: The gear train reverses the output direction in our example with two external gears.
examples.zh: 我们的示例使用两个外齿轮，这个「齿轮系」使输出方向反向。

words.enDefinition: Ratio relating input and output rotation rates according to a stated convention

examples.en: We calculated the gear ratio from the tooth counts of the meshing gears.
examples.zh: 我们根据啮合齿轮的齿数算出了「传动比」。

examples.en: The notes define the gear ratio as input speed divided by output speed.
examples.zh: 讲义将「传动比」定义为输入转速除以输出转速。

collocations: gear ratio of a meshing pair

words.enDefinition: Gear supplying torque and rotation to its mating gear in a stage

examples.en: The driver gear is attached to the shaft we turn in the tabletop model.
examples.zh: 「主动齿轮」固定在桌面模型中我们转动的那根轴上。

examples.en: We colored the driver gear blue to distinguish it from the receiving gear.
examples.zh: 我们将「主动齿轮」涂成蓝色，以便区分另一个接受动力的齿轮。

collocations: tooth count of the driver gear

words.enDefinition: Gear receiving torque and rotation from the mating driver in a stage

examples.en: The driven gear turns more slowly because it has twice as many teeth here.
examples.zh: 这里的「从动齿轮」有主动轮两倍的齿数，因此转得更慢。

examples.en: We drew an arrow showing the driven gear rotating opposite the input gear.
examples.zh: 我们用箭头表示「从动齿轮」的转动方向与输入齿轮相反。

collocations: tooth count of the driven gear

words.enDefinition: Intermediate gear transmitting rotation between other gears in a train

examples.en: The idler gear changes output direction without changing the overall speed ratio in this simple train.
examples.zh: 在这个简单齿轮系中，「惰轮」改变输出转向，同时保持总速比不变。

examples.en: We included an idler gear because the input and output centers were farther apart.
examples.zh: 由于输入和输出的中心相距较远，我们加入了一个「惰轮」。

collocations: gear train with an idler gear

words.enDefinition: Smaller gear of a meshing pair or gear engaging a rack

examples.en: The pinion in our drawing has fewer teeth than the mating gear.
examples.zh: 图中的「小齿轮」齿数少于与之啮合的齿轮。

examples.en: Turning the pinion moves the straight toothed bar in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 在课堂模型中，转动「小齿轮」会带动带齿的直杆移动。

collocations: mesh a pinion with a rack

words.enDefinition: Engagement between mating gear teeth as they transmit motion or torque

examples.en: The animation shows the gear mesh where teeth on both gears make contact.
examples.zh: 动画显示了两个齿轮的齿接触时发生「齿轮啮合」的位置。

examples.en: We inspected the gear mesh to see when the next pair of teeth engaged.
examples.zh: 我们观察「齿轮啮合」，查看下一对齿何时开始接触。

words.enDefinition: Cylindrical gear with straight teeth parallel to its axis of rotation

examples.en: The spur gear has straight teeth aligned with the shaft in our drawing.
examples.zh: 在我们图中，「直齿圆柱齿轮」的齿是直的，且与轴线平行。

examples.en: We used a spur gear pair on parallel shafts in the demonstration model.
examples.zh: 我们在演示模型的两根平行轴上用了一个「直齿圆柱齿轮」副。

words.enDefinition: Cylindrical gear whose teeth follow helical paths around its axis

examples.en: We identified a helical gear by the angled paths of the teeth around its cylinder.
examples.zh: 我们根据齿沿圆柱面倾斜盘绕的形状识别出了「斜齿圆柱齿轮」。

examples.en: The tutor compared tooth engagement for a helical gear and a spur gear.
examples.zh: 老师比较了「斜齿圆柱齿轮」和直齿圆柱齿轮的入啮过程。

words.enDefinition: Gear with a conical pitch surface, commonly transmitting motion between intersecting shafts

examples.en: The bevel gear redirects rotation between shafts meeting at an angle in the drawing.
examples.zh: 图中的「锥齿轮」在成角度相交的轴之间改变转动方向。

examples.en: We recognized the bevel gear by the cone shape marked on the model.
examples.zh: 我们根据模型上标出的锥形辨认出「锥齿轮」。

words.enDefinition: Toothed wheel that meshes with a screwlike worm in a transmission

examples.en: The worm wheel turns when the screwlike worm moves against its teeth.
examples.zh: 螺杆状蜗杆与齿啮合时，会带动「蜗轮」转动。

examples.en: We labeled the worm wheel separately from the worm in the illustration.
examples.zh: 我们在图中分别标出了「蜗轮」和蜗杆。

words.enDefinition: Mechanism combining a straight toothed rack with a meshing circular gear

examples.en: The rack and pinion turns the knob's rotation into straight movement of the model slider.
examples.zh: 「齿轮齿条机构」将旋钮的转动转换为模型滑块的直线运动。

examples.en: We used a rack and pinion to illustrate the connection between rotation and translation.
examples.zh: 我们用「齿轮齿条机构」演示了转动和平移之间的联系。

words.enDefinition: Gear assembly with a central gear and orbiting gears on a carrier

examples.en: Our planetary gear set diagram shows the smaller gears moving around the central gear.
examples.zh: 我们的「行星齿轮组」示意图显示较小的齿轮绕中央齿轮运动。

examples.en: We compared output rotation in the planetary gear set with two different components held fixed.
examples.zh: 我们分别固定「行星齿轮组」中两个不同的零件，比较其输出转动。

collocations: elements of a planetary gear set

words.enDefinition: Central gear meshing with planet gears in a planetary gear set

examples.en: We labeled the sun gear at the center of the planetary assembly.
examples.zh: 我们标出了行星齿轮组件中央的「太阳轮」。

examples.en: The sun gear drives three smaller gears in the classroom model's first arrangement.
examples.zh: 在课堂模型的第一种布置中，「太阳轮」驱动三个较小的齿轮。

words.enDefinition: Outer internally toothed gear surrounding the planets in a planetary assembly

examples.en: The ring gear surrounds the smaller gears and has teeth facing inward.
examples.zh: 「齿圈」包围着较小的齿轮，其齿朝内。

examples.en: We held the ring gear stationary when comparing the motions in our model.
examples.zh: 我们在比较模型中的运动时，保持「齿圈」静止。

words.enDefinition: Support locating the axes of the planet gears in a planetary assembly

examples.en: The planet carrier carries the small gears around the center of our model.
examples.zh: 「行星架」带着小齿轮绕我们模型的中心运动。

examples.en: We marked the planet carrier separately from the gears mounted on its pins.
examples.zh: 我们分别标出了「行星架」和装在其销轴上的齿轮。

words.enDefinition: Number of teeth around a gear or other toothed component

examples.en: Both gears have the same tooth count in this demonstration of direction reversal.
examples.zh: 在这个转向反转演示中，两个齿轮的「齿数」相等。

examples.en: We noted the tooth count before working out the ratio between the gears.
examples.zh: 我们先记下「齿数」，再算出两个齿轮之间的传动比。

words.enDefinition: Reference circle representing the ideal rolling action of a meshing gear

examples.en: We drew the pitch circle inside the tips of the external gear teeth.
examples.zh: 我们在外齿轮齿顶所围的圆内画出「分度圆」。

examples.en: The diagram shows how one pitch circle rolls against the other in the ideal model.
examples.zh: 示意图显示在理想模型中一个「分度圆」如何与另一个相切滚动。

words.enDefinition: Diameter of a gear's reference pitch circle

examples.en: We measured the pitch diameter across the reference circle shown on the gear sketch.
examples.zh: 我们跨过齿轮草图上所示的参考圆，测出「分度圆直径」。

examples.en: Two gears with the same tooth spacing have pitch diameter values proportional to tooth count.
examples.zh: 两个齿距相同的齿轮，其「分度圆直径」与齿数成正比。

words.enDefinition: Metric tooth-size measure given by pitch diameter divided by tooth count

examples.en: The tutor calculated gear module by dividing pitch diameter by the number of teeth.
examples.zh: 老师用分度圆直径除以齿数，求出了「齿轮模数」。

examples.en: We matched the gear module of the two spur gears used in the model.
examples.zh: 我们令模型所用的两个直齿圆柱齿轮采用相同的「齿轮模数」。

collocations: gears with the same gear module

words.enDefinition: Small clearance between mating tooth flanks, allowing motion on reversal before contact

examples.en: The diagram exaggerates gear backlash so we can see the gap change during reversal.
examples.zh: 图中放大了「齿轮侧隙」，让我们看清反向时的间隙变化。

examples.en: We observed gear backlash when the input moved slightly before the output began moving.
examples.zh: 输入端先稍微移动、输出端随后才开始运动时，我们观察到了「齿轮侧隙」。

words.enDefinition: Transmission using a moving belt stretched around two or more pulleys

examples.en: The belt drive transfers rotation between the two separated wheels in the model.
examples.zh: 「带传动」在模型中将转动从一个轮子传到另一个分开的轮子。

examples.en: We traced the belt drive around the pulleys drawn at different sizes.
examples.zh: 我们沿着绕过图中不同大小带轮的「带传动」路径观察。

words.enDefinition: Pulley putting the belt into motion and transmitting power into the drive

examples.en: The motor turns a small drive pulley that carries the belt around the model.
examples.zh: 电机带动一个小「主动带轮」，让皮带绕着模型运行。

examples.en: We labeled the drive pulley at the input end of the demonstration assembly.
examples.zh: 我们在演示组件的输入端标出了「主动带轮」。

words.enDefinition: Pulley guiding a belt or taking up slack without being the output

examples.en: The idler pulley redirects the belt between the two working pulleys in our sketch.
examples.zh: 在我们的草图中，「张紧轮」改变皮带在两个传动带轮之间的走向。

examples.en: We drew an idler pulley to show how the belt followed the curved path.
examples.zh: 我们画了一个「张紧轮」，说明皮带如何沿弯曲路线运动。

collocations: guide a belt with an idler pulley
belt path over an idler pulley

words.enDefinition: Toothed belt that meshes with pulleys to maintain synchronized motion

examples.en: The timing belt keeps the positions of the two rotating wheels coordinated in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中，「同步带」使两个转动轮的位置保持协调。

examples.en: We compared the teeth on the timing belt with the matching pulley grooves.
examples.zh: 我们将「同步带」上的齿与带轮上对应的槽作了比较。

collocations: synchronous motion with a timing belt

words.enDefinition: Belt with a tapered cross section that grips a matching pulley groove

examples.en: The V-belt fits the tapered pulley groove shown in the enlarged drawing.
examples.zh: 「V形带」与放大图所示的带轮楔形槽相配合。

examples.en: We identified the V-belt by looking at its shape in cross section.
examples.zh: 我们通过观察横截面的形状辨认出了「V形带」。

words.enDefinition: Mechanism transmitting rotation between toothed wheels using a moving chain

examples.en: The chain drive in our diagram connects two toothed wheels across an open space.
examples.zh: 图中的「链传动」跨过一段间隔，连接两个有齿的轮子。

examples.en: We compared a chain drive with a smooth belt in our transmission exercise.
examples.zh: 在传动练习中，我们把「链传动」与光面皮带作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Toothed wheel that engages a chain and transmits its motion

examples.en: The sprocket teeth engage the spaces between links in the drawing.
examples.zh: 图中「链轮」的齿与链节之间的空隙啮合。

examples.en: We counted the teeth on the sprocket before comparing the two rotation rates.
examples.zh: 我们先数出「链轮」的齿数，再比较两种转速。

collocations: drive a chain with a sprocket

words.enDefinition: Use of a gear arrangement to lower output speed relative to input speed

examples.en: Our model uses gear reduction so the display plate turns slower than the motor.
examples.zh: 我们的模型使用「齿轮减速」，使展板转得比电机慢。

examples.en: We showed gear reduction with a small driving gear turning a larger driven gear.
examples.zh: 我们用小主动轮驱动大从动轮，演示了「齿轮减速」。

collocations: calculate the effect of gear reduction

words.enDefinition: Ratio of useful output power to input power in a transmission

examples.en: We used the input and output power readings to estimate transmission efficiency.
examples.zh: 我们用输入和输出功率的读数估算了「传动效率」。

examples.en: The model has lower transmission efficiency when more energy is lost through friction.
examples.zh: 摩擦造成的能量损失更多时，模型的「传动效率」更低。

words.enDefinition: Oscillating motion of a physical system about a reference position

examples.en: The sensor records mechanical vibration as the tabletop model moves above and below its rest position.
examples.zh: 桌面模型在静止位置上下往复运动时，传感器记录其「机械振动」。

examples.en: We compared mechanical vibration in two models that used different springs and equal masses.
examples.zh: 我们比较了采用不同弹簧、质量相同的两个模型中的「机械振动」。

words.enDefinition: One complete repetition of oscillatory motion returning to the same phase

examples.en: We counted one vibration cycle when the slider returned to the same position and direction.
examples.zh: 滑块回到同一位置并朝同一方向运动时，我们计为「一次完整振动」。

examples.en: We marked the start and end of a vibration cycle on the repeating trace.
examples.zh: 我们在重复的曲线上标出了「一次完整振动」的起点和终点。

words.enDefinition: Elapsed time required for one complete repeat of an oscillation

examples.en: We measured the oscillation period between two adjacent peaks on the repeating trace.
examples.zh: 我们测量了重复曲线上两个相邻波峰之间的「振动周期」。

examples.en: A longer oscillation period means the model completes fewer cycles in one second.
examples.zh: 「振动周期」较长意味着模型在一秒内完成的循环次数较少。

words.enDefinition: Number of complete oscillations per unit time of a periodic motion

examples.en: The trace has a higher oscillation frequency when more cycles fit into one second.
examples.zh: 当曲线在一秒内显示更多循环时，「振动频率」更高。

examples.en: We found the oscillation frequency from the reciprocal of time between successive peaks.
examples.zh: 我们用相邻波峰之间时间间隔的倒数求出了「振动频率」。

words.enDefinition: Maximum displacement magnitude from the reference position during the oscillation considered

examples.en: On this symmetric trace, the vibration amplitude is the distance from center line to peak.
examples.zh: 对这条对称曲线，中心线到波峰的距离就是「振幅」。

examples.en: We compared the vibration amplitude across cycles as the motion gradually became smaller.
examples.zh: 随着运动幅度逐渐缩小，我们比较了各循环的「振幅」。

words.enDefinition: Difference between the largest and smallest measured displacements over an interval

examples.en: We measured peak-to-peak displacement from the top of the trace to its lowest point.
examples.zh: 我们从曲线的最高点量到最低点，得到了「峰峰位移」。

examples.en: For this symmetric trace, peak-to-peak displacement is twice the displacement amplitude from the center.
examples.zh: 对于这条对称曲线，「峰峰位移」是相对中心线测得振幅的两倍。

words.enDefinition: A configuration where the generalized forces on the stationary system balance under the stated loads.

examples.en: We marked the equilibrium position before pulling the mass a short distance aside.
examples.zh: 将重物轻轻拉开一小段距离之前，我们先标出了「平衡位置」。

examples.en: The model oscillates around its equilibrium position after being released from an offset.
examples.zh: 模型从偏离的位置释放后，围绕其「平衡位置」振动。

collocations: move away from the equilibrium position

words.enDefinition: Model whose configuration can be described by one independent coordinate

examples.en: The slider forms a single-degree-of-freedom system because only its horizontal position can change.
examples.zh: 滑块构成「单自由度系统」，因为只有它的水平位置可以变化。

examples.en: We represented the single-degree-of-freedom system using displacement along the guide as its only coordinate.
examples.zh: 我们用沿导轨的位移作为唯一坐标来表示这个「单自由度系统」。

words.enDefinition: Independent variable describing one part of a mechanical system's configuration

examples.en: We chose the swing angle as a generalized coordinate for the pendulum model.
examples.zh: 我们选择摆角作为摆模型的一个「广义坐标」。

examples.en: The tutor explained why either distance or angle could serve as a generalized coordinate.
examples.zh: 老师解释了为什么距离或角度都可以用作「广义坐标」。

words.enDefinition: Mechanical model pairing a moving mass with a spring providing restoring force

examples.en: The spring-mass system on the worksheet uses one mass moving along a guide.
examples.zh: 习题中的「弹簧质量系统」由一个沿导轨运动的质量块组成。

examples.en: We released the spring-mass system from an offset and plotted its idealized motion.
examples.zh: 我们把「弹簧质量系统」从偏离位置释放，并画出了它的理想化运动。

collocations: natural frequency of a spring-mass system

words.enDefinition: Mechanical model combining inertia, spring restoring force, and a damping element

examples.en: The mass-spring-damper system includes a damper that makes its free motion gradually die away.
examples.zh: 「质量弹簧阻尼系统」有一个阻尼器，使自由运动逐渐消退。

examples.en: We identified the separate force terms in the mass-spring-damper system shown on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们识别出习题中「质量弹簧阻尼系统」里的各项力。

words.enDefinition: Force component tending to move a displaced system back toward equilibrium

examples.en: The arrow for the restoring force points toward equilibrium when the spring is stretched.
examples.zh: 弹簧被拉伸时，表示「回复力」的箭头指向平衡位置。

examples.en: We drew the restoring force for displacements on both sides of the rest position.
examples.zh: 我们分别画出了静止位置两侧的位移所对应的「回复力」。

words.enDefinition: Spring modeled with force proportional to extension or compression over its range

examples.en: A linear spring produces twice the force magnitude when its extension is doubled.
examples.zh: 「线性弹簧」的伸长量加倍时，力的大小也加倍。

examples.en: The worksheet represents the linear spring with a straight force versus displacement line.
examples.zh: 习题用一条力随位移变化的直线表示「线性弹簧」。

words.enDefinition: Change in spring force magnitude per unit deflection in the linear model

examples.en: We estimated spring stiffness from the slope of the force versus extension graph.
examples.zh: 我们根据力与伸长量关系图的斜率估算了「弹簧刚度」。

examples.en: Greater spring stiffness gives a larger restoring force for the same displacement here.
examples.zh: 在这个模型中，「弹簧刚度」更大时，相同位移对应的回复力更大。

words.enDefinition: Device modeled as exerting an opposing force proportional to relative velocity

examples.en: Our model uses a viscous damper to represent energy lost during each cycle.
examples.zh: 我们的模型用「黏性阻尼器」表示每个循环中损失的能量。

examples.en: The viscous damper exerts no force when both ends have the same velocity.
examples.zh: 「黏性阻尼器」两端速度相同时，它不产生阻尼力。

words.enDefinition: Damping modeled by a resisting force proportional to the relative velocity

examples.en: The model uses viscous damping, with a larger opposing force at higher speed.
examples.zh: 模型使用「黏性阻尼」，运动速率较高时，阻力更大。

examples.en: We used viscous damping to explain why the free motion gradually lost energy.
examples.zh: 我们用「黏性阻尼」解释了自由运动的机械能为何逐渐减少。

words.enDefinition: Proportionality relating opposing force magnitude to relative speed in a viscous model

examples.en: We changed the damping coefficient while keeping the spring and mass terms fixed.
examples.zh: 我们改变了「阻尼系数」，同时保持弹簧和质量项不变。

examples.en: The slope of the force versus speed plot gives the damping coefficient here.
examples.zh: 这里的力与速率关系图的斜率给出了「阻尼系数」。

words.enDefinition: Viscous damping value at the boundary between oscillatory and nonoscillatory free responses

examples.en: We compared the model's damping with the critical damping coefficient before classifying the motion.
examples.zh: 我们将模型的阻尼系数与「临界阻尼系数」比较，再判断运动类型。

examples.en: The critical damping coefficient depends on both mass and stiffness in our linear model.
examples.zh: 在我们的线性模型中，「临界阻尼系数」取决于质量和刚度。

collocations: compare with the critical damping coefficient

words.enDefinition: Sinusoidal motion whose acceleration is proportional and opposite to displacement from equilibrium

examples.en: The ideal slider shows simple harmonic motion when the model ignores damping and outside forcing.
examples.zh: 模型忽略阻尼和外部激励时，理想滑块做「简谐运动」。

examples.en: We drew simple harmonic motion as a repeating sine curve centered on its rest position.
examples.zh: 我们把「简谐运动」画成以静止位置为中心的重复正弦曲线。

words.enDefinition: Motion following an initial disturbance without continuing external excitation

examples.en: After the initial pull, the slider undergoes free vibration with no continuing push.
examples.zh: 初次拉动结束后，滑块在没有持续推力的情况下做「自由振动」。

examples.en: We recorded free vibration to examine how the model behaves after release.
examples.zh: 我们记录了「自由振动」，观察模型在释放之后的运动。

words.enDefinition: Oscillation without ongoing excitation or modeled energy dissipation

examples.en: The amplitudes stay constant during undamped free vibration in our idealized spring model.
examples.zh: 在我们理想化的弹簧模型中，「无阻尼自由振动」的振幅保持不变。

examples.en: We simulated undamped free vibration before adding a term representing energy loss.
examples.zh: 我们先模拟了「无阻尼自由振动」，然后加入表示能量损失的项。

words.enDefinition: Motion after an initial disturbance with energy loss and no continuing excitation

examples.en: The peaks shrink during damped free vibration because the model loses energy each cycle.
examples.zh: 在「有阻尼自由振动」期间，模型每循环一次都会损失能量，因此峰值逐次减小。

examples.en: We identified damped free vibration after the initial release produced a sequence of smaller peaks.
examples.zh: 初次释放后出现了一连串逐渐减小的峰值，据此我们识别出「有阻尼自由振动」。

words.enDefinition: Oscillatory motion sustained by a time-varying external input to the system

examples.en: The periodic input produces forced vibration in the small spring model on our worksheet.
examples.zh: 周期输入在习题的小型弹簧模型中产生了「受迫振动」。

examples.en: We compared forced vibration with the motion observed just after an isolated pull.
examples.zh: 我们把「受迫振动」与一次单独拉动后观察到的运动作了比较。

words.enDefinition: External input varying sinusoidally with time at a single frequency

examples.en: The simulation uses harmonic excitation to represent a repeating sinusoidal push on the mass.
examples.zh: 仿真用「简谐激励」表示作用于质量块的周期性正弦推力。

examples.en: We drew the harmonic excitation on the same time scale as the displacement.
examples.zh: 我们用同一时间刻度画出了「简谐激励」和位移。

words.enDefinition: Number of cycles per unit time of the applied periodic input

examples.en: We changed the forcing frequency and recorded the amplitude after the transient settled.
examples.zh: 我们改变了「激励频率」，并在瞬态运动消退后记录振幅。

examples.en: The model keeps forcing frequency fixed while changing the size of the applied force.
examples.zh: 模型改变外力大小，同时保持「激励频率」不变。

words.enDefinition: Frequency of free oscillation predicted for a system with damping omitted

examples.en: We calculated the undamped natural frequency from mass and stiffness in the ideal model.
examples.zh: 我们用理想模型中的质量和刚度计算了「无阻尼固有频率」。

examples.en: The undamped natural frequency rises when stiffness increases while the mass stays fixed.
examples.zh: 质量固定不变时，刚度增加会使「无阻尼固有频率」升高。

words.enDefinition: Frequency of free oscillation in a system with undercritical damping

examples.en: We estimated the damped natural frequency from the gaps between peaks after release.
examples.zh: 我们用释放后相邻峰值的时间间隔估算了「阻尼固有频率」。

examples.en: The damped natural frequency is lower than the undamped value in our linear model.
examples.zh: 在我们的线性模型中，「阻尼固有频率」低于无阻尼时的数值。

words.enDefinition: Dimensionless ratio of actual viscous damping to the critical damping coefficient

examples.en: We changed the damping ratio to compare the free motion shown in each trace.
examples.zh: 我们改变「阻尼比」，比较各条曲线所显示的自由运动。

examples.en: The notes show that the damping ratio is unchanged when we switch to another unit system.
examples.zh: 讲义说明，换用另一套单位制时，「阻尼比」不变。

words.enDefinition: Damping below the critical level, allowing decaying oscillations during free motion

examples.en: The plotted motion demonstrates underdamping because it repeatedly crosses equilibrium with shrinking peaks.
examples.zh: 绘出的运动反复穿过平衡位置且峰值逐次减小，体现了「欠阻尼」。

examples.en: We labeled the oscillatory decay in the lower graph as underdamping.
examples.zh: 我们将下图中的衰减振动标记为「欠阻尼」。

words.enDefinition: Damping level separating oscillatory from nonoscillatory free motion in the linear model

examples.en: The graph labeled critical damping marks the boundary between the two response types.
examples.zh: 标有「临界阻尼」的图对应两种响应类型的分界。

examples.en: In our release-from-rest model, critical damping returns the mass fastest without repeated crossings.
examples.zh: 在我们从静止状态释放质量块的模型中，「临界阻尼」使质量块最快趋回平衡位置，且不反复穿过该点。

words.enDefinition: Damping above the critical level, producing a nonoscillatory return toward equilibrium

examples.en: The trace for overdamping approaches equilibrium gradually without repeated crossings in our model.
examples.zh: 我们的模型中，「过阻尼」的曲线逐渐趋近平衡位置，不反复穿过该位置。

examples.en: We identified overdamping after comparing the modeled damping level with its critical value.
examples.zh: 我们将模型阻尼水平与临界值比较后，识别出了「过阻尼」。

words.enDefinition: Enhanced response when periodic excitation lies near a system's characteristic frequency

examples.en: The desktop spring model shows resonance as the forcing frequency approaches a response peak.
examples.zh: 激励频率接近响应曲线的峰值频率时，桌面弹簧模型呈现「共振」。

examples.en: We discussed resonance by comparing response amplitudes at several forcing frequencies.
examples.zh: 我们比较若干激励频率下的响应振幅，讨论了「共振」。

words.enDefinition: Excitation frequency giving a peak in the specified steady-state response

examples.en: We marked the resonant frequency at the peak of the displacement response curve.
examples.zh: 我们在位移响应曲线的峰值处标出了「共振频率」。

examples.en: The resonant frequency can differ from the undamped frequency when damping is present.
examples.zh: 存在阻尼时，「共振频率」可能不同于无阻尼固有频率。

words.enDefinition: Forcing frequency divided by the undamped natural frequency in a vibration model

examples.en: The graph plots displacement amplitude against frequency ratio for three modeled damping values.
examples.zh: 图中按三组模型阻尼值绘出了位移振幅随「频率比」变化的曲线。

examples.en: We calculated the frequency ratio using the two frequencies in the same units.
examples.zh: 我们用单位一致的两个频率算出了「频率比」。

words.enDefinition: Continuing oscillation remaining once transient effects from initial conditions decay

examples.en: We recorded steady-state vibration after the initial motion had settled into a repeating pattern.
examples.zh: 初始运动逐渐稳定为重复波形后，我们记录了「稳态振动」。

examples.en: The steady-state vibration in our linear model repeats at the applied driving frequency.
examples.zh: 在线性模型中，「稳态振动」按施加的激励频率重复。

words.enDefinition: Angle showing how far a sinusoidal response trails its driving input

examples.en: We estimated the phase lag in forced vibration by comparing the peaks of the output and input.
examples.zh: 我们比较输出与输入的峰值位置，估出了「受迫振动的相位滞后」。

examples.en: The diagram shows phase lag in forced vibration because the displacement peaks occur after the force peaks.
examples.zh: 位移峰值在力峰值之后出现，因此图中显示了「受迫振动的相位滞后」。

collocations: measure the phase lag in forced vibration
plot phase lag in forced vibration
explain phase lag in forced vibration

words.enDefinition: Variation of displacement produced by excitation or initial conditions in a model

examples.en: We plotted the displacement response after releasing the model from a small offset.
examples.zh: 我们让模型从略微偏离的位置释放，然后画出了「位移响应」。

examples.en: The displacement response shows the motion's changing size during the first several cycles.
examples.zh: 「位移响应」显示了运动幅度在最初几次循环中的变化。

words.enDefinition: Reduction of vibration transmitted between a vibrating object and its surroundings

examples.en: We discussed vibration isolation using two tabletop platforms with different support materials.
examples.zh: 我们用采用不同支撑材料的两个桌面平台来讨论「隔振」。

examples.en: The vibration isolation demonstration compares motion on the model's two sides using plotted traces.
examples.zh: 「隔振」演示通过绘制的曲线比较模型两侧的运动。

collocations: vibration isolation in a tabletop model

words.enDefinition: Natural logarithm of the ratio of successive same-direction free-decay peak amplitudes

examples.en: We found the logarithmic decrement from two successive positive peaks in the decay curve.
examples.zh: 我们用衰减曲线上相邻的两个正峰求出了「对数减量」。

examples.en: The tutor used the logarithmic decrement to estimate damping from the model's recorded motion.
examples.zh: 老师用「对数减量」从模型的运动记录中估算阻尼。

collocations: estimate damping using the logarithmic decrement
logarithmic decrement of a decay trace

words.enDefinition: Curve bounding the amplitudes of a decaying oscillation over time

examples.en: We drew the vibration decay envelope around the shrinking swings in the motion trace.
examples.zh: 我们沿运动曲线逐渐缩小的摆动外缘画出「振动衰减包络线」。

examples.en: The vibration decay envelope falls more quickly in the model with stronger undercritical damping.
examples.zh: 在仍属欠阻尼但阻尼较强的模型中，「振动衰减包络线」下降得更快。

collocations: shape of the vibration decay envelope
